about: Gates the release evidence report looks up for a release of this repository (release-evidence.mjs). A gate is decided by the newest completed run at the release commit, else on the release-candidate branches. Gates in Atlas-Authorization/pca are looked up at that repository's tag of the same version.

gates.label: CI: workspace, atlas-pca on Linux / macOS / Windows, zkVM receipt verifier
Cross-language gate (this verifier against the other 8)
Kani bounded model checking of the Rust verifier

known_exceptions: crates.io keeps no provenance: the attested .crate files on this Release and the index checksum comparison are the record.

stark-pca is in the experimental maturity tier and pca-folding-ivc in the hardened tier (awaiting audit); the axum middleware of atlas-pca checks the proof only (no caveats, replay or revocation) (https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/pca/blob/main/docs/maturity.md).
